title: Secrecy briefing at Kilo control and ostracism after the incident
place_text: Kilo control, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: Well, when I was sent to KE control, I got a real strict briefing from Master Sergeant Gray
We were told never to speak with anyone about any of this so I never did, as ordered.

plain: After his 1977 encounter at a nuclear missile site near Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, the former Air Force missile security guard Mario Woods says he was sent to Kilo control, one of the posts that ran the missile field, and given "a real strict briefing" by a Master Sergeant Gray. He tells Michels this himself, as someone it happened to, and also brings up a Colonel Spraker in connection with what came next. The journalist Robert Hastings, who writes about UFOs at nuclear sites, gave the same account in a 2017 article, where Woods says: "We were told never to speak with anyone about any of this so I never did, as ordered." Woods tells it this way: the men who saw the incident were made to keep quiet, and he says afterwards he was kept at arm's length. If that is true, the Air Force would have known something happened and chosen to bury it.
